seoTitle: How to Use Asana's Advanced Features Easily
metaDescription: Explore Asana's advanced tools in 2026, from multi-branch automation and formula fields to portfolios, workload management, and AI status summaries.
intro: Once a team outgrows basic boards, Asana's higher-tier features unlock a lot more control over scale, from conditional automation to AI-generated status updates. This guide walks through building advanced rules, calculating metrics with formula fields, and monitoring team capacity across an entire organization.

steps.heading: Build multi-branch automation rules
steps.body: Construct automation rules using conditional statements and multi-branch triggers to handle more complex logic than simple single-action rules.

steps.heading: Configure formula fields
steps.body: Create custom fields that use numerical formulas to calculate values across task rows, such as totals or variances.

steps.heading: Set up master portfolios
steps.body: Build a portfolio view to monitor health, deadlines, and budgets across many independent projects from a single dashboard.

steps.heading: Use workload management
steps.body: Open the workload panel to balance team capacity, track individual hours, and redistribute tasks when someone is overloaded.

steps.heading: Leverage Asana Intelligence
steps.body: Use built-in AI features to generate instant status updates and smart summaries for stakeholders instead of writing them manually.

faq.question: Do advanced features require a higher-tier Asana plan?
faq.answer: Yes, features like workload management, portfolios, and advanced automation rules are generally available on higher-tier plans.

faq.question: Can formula fields reference values from other tasks?
faq.answer: Formula fields can calculate values based on other fields within the same task row, giving you real-time computed metrics.

faq.question: What does Asana Intelligence actually generate?
faq.answer: It can produce automated status summaries and progress updates based on your project's current task data, saving time on manual reporting.

faq.question: How does workload management help balance my team?
faq.answer: It gives you a visual panel showing individual capacity and task hours, so you can redistribute work before anyone gets overloaded.
